static_observation: CWFInterface txPower sends a query using a synchronous XPC proxy. The reply callback calls doubleValue and stores it.
The separate Apple80211 transmit-power handler boxes a signed integer taken from the reply structure.

static_data_flow: Calls the firmware variable getter with qtxpower and no setting payload.
Reads the first byte of the returned result.
Converts the quarter-dBm byte with the uint16 milliwatt table and rounded integer division.
Writes the converted value to the result structure.

limitations: The byte value on this Mac is inferred from the host conversion and the matching public readout.
XPC server dispatch, firmware return bytes and physical RF power were not observed.
The Linux driver uses 127 for automatic policy. This does not independently establish the active macOS policy flag.

method.driver: Disassemble getTXPOWER with the installed dyld_info for each architecture. Resolve the firmware-variable string and the lookup-table reference through the Mach-O segment mappings. Compare the 40 little-endian uint16 entries with the published Broadcom table.
method.frameworks: Inspect the public getter and the relevant CoreWiFi methods with dyld_info. Resolve the direct Objective-C selector stubs through file-backed dyld shared-cache mappings.
method.sample: Run tools/read_wifi_status.swift --sample 6 0.5 and retain only the aggregate configurations and reported power values. Read the default interface before and after.

public_wrapper.static_observation: Gets the CoreWiFi object, calls the txPower selector, and converts the double to an integer toward zero.
